claims.text: A randomized controlled trial at a Chinese travel agency found that employees working from home were roughly 13 percent more productive than their in-office counterparts, and that attrition fell by half.
claims.note: Chinese travel agency RCT, 13% more productive

claims.text: Meanwhile, commercial office vacancy rates in major American cities reached record highs after 2020, which has put real pressure on municipal tax bases that depend on commercial property assessments.
claims.note: Office vacancy rates hit record highs

claims.text: Research suggests that fully remote workers are less likely to be promoted than colleagues who come in, a gap sometimes attributed to reduced visibility rather than reduced output.
claims.note: Remote workers less likely to be promoted
